description.zh: 漏洞的处理方式。固定取值：**vul_fix**，表示修复漏洞。
description.en: The method to handle the vulnerability. Set the value to **vul_fix**, which indicates fixing the vulnerability.

description.zh: 要修复的漏洞的类型。固定取值：**cve**，表示Linux软件漏洞。
description.en: The type of vulnerability to fix. Set the value to **cve**, which indicates a Linux software vulnerability.

description.zh: 要修复漏洞的服务器的UUID列表。
description.en: The UUIDs of the servers on which you want to fix the vulnerabilities.

description.zh: 要修复的漏洞的名称列表。
description.en: The names of the vulnerabilities to fix.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas operate-vuls --type cve --operate-type vul_fix --vul-names oval:com.ubuntu.xenial:def:2020355240000000 --uuids 14f14260-xxxx-46ea-a157-451983a10000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas OperateVuls --region cn-hangzhou --Type cve --VulNames.1 'oval:com.ubuntu.xenial:def:2020355240000000' --Uuids.1 '14f14260-xxxx-46ea-a157-451983a10000' --OperateType vul_fix
